## AI

### Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 AI model
🔥🔥🔥🔥◯ Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, its fourth model release in under two months following Fable 5 (June), Sonnet 5 (June), and Opus 4.8 (May 28). Per Anthropic's own announcement, Claude Opus 5 is available today. It's a thoughtful and proactive model that comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price. It carries the same pricing as its predecessor, and on benchmarks it costs $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, the same price as its predecessor. On coding evaluations, On Frontier-Bench, a coding evaluation that measures whether models can build working software from engineering drawings, Opus 5 more than doubles its predecessor's score and surpasses every competing model, including Fable 5. Anthropic also says the model is its most aligned to date, with a "least likely to behave deceptively" rating in internal safety audits, and Opus 5 is now the default model on Claude Max and the strongest option on Claude Pro.
Sources: [Google News — Anthropic](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE9ULXZ2Vl9hdEVvYzkxbV9PNjc2MDBMWDBLVE1ORi1vYnlZR1B4QzNlUGx1dFNmd09Hc3AxbTlEN0V2X0FlaDhuV01WQnRrS0tQZUZLOXAwV2d5Mnl5eVhaZUc1LUZkU3EtX0JIRkREdzJJOElQbjNhLWJZVQ?oc=5), [thenextweb.com](https://thenextweb.com/news/anthropic-claude-opus-5-launch-frontier-bench-coding), [anthropic.com](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5)

## Funding

### Anthropic preparing for IPO with executive hiring
🔥🔥◯◯◯ Anthropic posted a job listing for a Director of Investor Relations, with pay far above the summary's stated $42: reporting shows Anthropic is offering a base salary of $425,000 to $600,000 for a director of investor relations role. The hire comes as AI firm prepares for blockbuster IPO and Wall Street debut, with one report noting the listing exists as Anthropic operates as a public benefit corporation weighing a public listing.
Sources: [Google News — Anthropic](https://news.google.?oc=5), [storyboard18.com](https://www.storyboard18.com/amp/brand-marketing/anthropic-offers-up-to-600000-salary-for-key-investor-relations-role-ahead-of-ipo-ws-l-104817.htm)
